scope: AutoGraphs opens original default actual series on Simple/Eco evolving startup boundaries; no engine or graph formula changes.

source_contract.fact: fixcam startup: y_graphs plus restart modes4/5 opens population, average mutations, total species energy.
StartSimul resets camfix; first startup loop calls fixcam once; NewGraph keeps an existing chart, shows it and feeds its first sample.
F1 testing mode6 transitions back to evolving mode4 on win/loss; Zerobot7/8 is outside the default graph gate.

implementation.mode_gate: Running SimpleSurvival/EcoSurvival with persisted auto_graphs=true, source Simple/Eco configuration and phase evolving.
implementation.boundary: First eligible published snapshot or changed(kind,restart_count). Publications captured while common Load is in flight defer automatic graph opening. After session.LoadAsync succeeds, reset/open once from its committed LatestSnapshot. A rejected load and a canceled picker leave the existing boundary intact; subsequent ordinary publication does not reopen closed defaults.
implementation.preservation: Open only missing metrics. Keep existing chart objects/history and manual chooser selection. Closing a graph does not reopen it on an ordinary snapshot; next eligible startup/restart/load reopens only missing defaults.
implementation.manual: Graphs button still opens/activates the chooser without opening a chart.
implementation.publication: Open after queued native snapshot presentation, including automatic process-style restarts. Remove the old Start handler empty-chooser special case.
implementation.load_routes: Toolbar and legacy menu share existing LoadSimulationAsync. This is the only production path consolidation; engine/session persistence and loading algorithms unchanged.

load_ordering_source.rule: Enqueue Load; successful Action then Snapshot/LatestSnapshot/Event then completion; an exception completes faulted without snapshot publication.

Storage cancel returns before common load. UI snapshot posts capture loading flag on event dispatch. Loading presentations defer auto-opening; success resumes on UI context and opens from committed LatestSnapshot.
